notes:
New feature added! → You can now customize each component through the new slider panel. I really like being able to dogfood the components I build and experiment with them directly within my own project, for visual things like this it’s the best kind of testing Now that all the core functionality are there, the upcoming updates will be less visible but still important: proper keyboard navigation, improved accessibility, a reduced motion toggle, and more

Designer: @lorenzodossi. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
